applications_date_range.name: applications_date_range
applications_date_range.value: "applications"."date_applied" IS NULL OR "applications"."date_found" IS NULL OR "applications"."date_applied" >= "applications"."date_found"

candidate_projects_date_range.name: candidate_projects_date_range
candidate_projects_date_range.value: "candidate_projects"."start_date" IS NULL OR "candidate_projects"."end_date" IS NULL OR "candidate_projects"."end_date" >= "candidate_projects"."start_date"

interviews_timestamp_order.name: interviews_timestamp_order
interviews_timestamp_order.value: "interviews"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "interviews"."scheduled_at" IS NULL OR "interviews"."completed_at" >= "interviews"."scheduled_at"

job_analyses_terminal_timestamp_order.name: job_analyses_terminal_timestamp_order
job_analyses_terminal_timestamp_order.value: ("job_analyses"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "job_analyses"."completed_at" >= "job_analyses"."started_at") AND ("job_analyses"."failed_at" IS NULL OR "job_analyses"."failed_at" >= "job_analyses"."started_at")

job_analyses_state_consistency.name: job_analyses_state_consistency
job_analyses_state_consistency.value:
(
        ("job_analyses"."status" = 'RUNNING' AND "job_analyses"."analysis_data" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."suggested_score" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."failure_message" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."failed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("job_analyses"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "job_analyses"."analysis_data" IS NOT NULL AND "job_analyses"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."failure_message" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "job_analyses"."failed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("job_analyses"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "job_analyses"."analysis_data" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."suggested_score" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "job_analyses"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

research_claims_value_required.name: research_claims_value_required
research_claims_value_required.value: "research_claims"."value_text" IS NOT NULL OR "research_claims"."value_json" IS NOT NULL

researches_terminal_timestamp_order.name: researches_terminal_timestamp_order
researches_terminal_timestamp_order.value: ("researches"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "researches"."completed_at" >= "researches"."started_at") AND ("researches"."failed_at" IS NULL OR "researches"."failed_at" >= "researches"."started_at")

researches_state_consistency.name: researches_state_consistency
researches_state_consistency.value:
(
        ("researches"."status" = 'RUNNING' AND "researches"."summary_markdown" IS NULL AND "researches"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "researches"."failure_message" IS NULL AND "researches"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "researches"."failed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("researches"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "researches"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "researches"."failure_message" IS NULL AND "researches"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "researches"."failed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("researches"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "researches"."summary_markdown" IS NULL AND "researches"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "researches"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )
